name: com.kensei.ecs
description: Lightweight sparse-set Entity Component System: generational entities, reactive filters, zero-allocation iteration, debug validation and editor tools.

samples.description: Entities bouncing around an arena: an EcsBootstrap subclass with Update, FixedUpdate and LateUpdate systems, a one-frame event, inspector-authored components via EcsComponentProvider and a spawner that uses EcsEntityView.Spawn.
